title: The shipped plugin carried the tests' tooling, not the tests
description: plugins/ork/hooks shipped seven test/build configs — four vitest manifests, two tsconfigs, esbuild.config.mjs — to every install, read by nothing: Claude Code executes prebuilt dist/ bundles via hooks.json, and #3971 had already stripped the devDependencies those configs reference. The fix is seven excludes appended to the existing rsync block, and a two-half ratchet test whose B-side dry-runs the real exclude list (dialect-agnostic across macOS openrsync and CI GNU rsync).
